patch_description: This replaces the previous continuation-only search with a population-based jam-and-polish strategy. It creates a diverse pool of staggered, asymmetric, mirrored, and locally perturbed layered packings, evaluates each through constrained nonlinear optimization, then re-solves only the strongest candidates at substantially tighter tolerances. This concentrates expensive refinement on promising contact graphs while exploring more boundary-sensitive row arrangements than a single local basin. Exact constraint Jacobians and a final uniform certification scale preserve validity.
